role: No-fit description of measured pressure-flow evolution
source: Waszkiewicz et al. (2025), Zenodo 18046315; authenticated native traces, same 56 distinct brews as Stage A and FORM_A
rights: CC-BY-4.0 data; original figure, no source artwork or GPL program imported
observation: 2-s centered time averages of native 31-sample filtered mass derivative and matched line pressure

encodings.x: Condition-mean achieved line pressure (bar), same available brews as y
encodings.panels: Since stable pressure; since detected Waszkiewicz onset
encodings.colors: Declared window center; stable 100 s is black and heavier
encodings.lines: Connections among observed nominal-condition means; not fitted curves
encodings.uncertainty: Point estimates drawn; shared whole-brew bootstrap intervals and paired changes in CSVs
encodings.missingness: Missing condition means break curves; all 110 actual condition-time cells have full support

ceiling: Source-internal temporal description, not a located peak, common mechanism, puck pressure or validation
